newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil's Cesp still neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil's Cesp still neutral.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it was maintaining its neutral rating on Sao Paulo state power firm Cesp.

-- In a report, the brokerage said Cesp should benefit from its privatization, expected to begin in the second half of 1997, as most of the sell-off proceeds are likely to be used to reduce the company's debts, currently nearly at $9.0 billion.
-- But it noted that its privatization poses some risks to minority shareholders, "which will have to be considered in its likely corporate restructuring."

-- Merrill Lynch said Sao Paulo state's plans are to split Cesp in up to ten units -- seven generating firms, two distributors and one transmission company. The transmission company would remain under control of the state government, while the distribution and generating units would be privatized.
-- Cesp preferred was flat at 50 reais in late afternoon trade on the Sao Paulo bourse.
